speaker: charlie
text: G'day and welcome to ParkSyde Bright Side, I'm Alex Mercer bringing you Thursday's good news bulletin. It's looking like a ripper of a day ahead with Jamie and our weather wizard Sam. Jamie, ready to spread some sunshine?

speaker: alice
text: Too right Alex! We've got some absolute crackers today that'll put a smile on your dial. From breakthrough science discoveries to massive wins for our planet, there's plenty to celebrate.

speaker: charlie
text: And speaking of celebration, today marks exactly 55 years since Marvin Gaye released 'What's Going On' - that legendary album that became Motown's biggest seller. Sometimes the good stuff just keeps getting better with age, doesn't it?
